title: Module 4 Quiz: Banks Keep Money Safe

questions.text: What cannot hurt the money kept in the bank's vault?
questions.explanation: The narration says rain, fire, and sleepy puppies cannot touch the money.

questions.text: What happens to interest when you save more money in a savings account?
questions.explanation: The narration says the more you save, the bigger the thank‑you (interest) gets over time.

questions.text: What does your bank card act like when you use it?
questions.explanation: The narration says a card is a special key that unlocks your very own bank vault.

questions.text: A savings account is for spending money every day.
questions.explanation: The narration says a savings account is not for spending every day; it is for keeping money safe for something special.
